mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.title, r.status, r.review_status, r.process_type, r.create_time, r.user_id, r.dept_id FROM brain_editorial_review r
mapper.select: SELECT i.business_id AS review_id, t.id AS task_id, t.instance_id AS instance_id, t.node_code, t.node_name FROM flow_task t INNER JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id AND i.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN flow_user u ON u.associated = t.id AND u.del_flag = '0' WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND t.node_type = 1 AND i.business_id = #{reviewId} AND u.processed_by = #{processedBy} AND u.type IN ('1', '2', '3') ORDER BY t.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
